candidates.change_summary: Change the final return statement to return false instead of true.
Removed the revert on failed transferFrom call, so failed token transfers no longer cause the whole call to revert.
Replaced the decimals scaling computation with the raw value, so the amount passed to transferFrom is v instead of v * 10 ** _decimals.
Changed the loop condition to `i < 1` so only the first recipient receives tokens even when multiple addresses are supplied.
